newsitem.title: USA: Health and Retirement ups credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Health and Retirement ups credit facility.

text.p: Health and Retirement Properties Trust said Thursday it increased by $200 million the capacity of its revolving bank credit facility to $450 million.
The trust said the revolving credit facility was increased to permit more flexibility in funding acquisitions.
The revolving credit facility matures in March 2001.
Funding for the $450 million credit facility is provided by 20 commercial lenders.
The trust said it uses this credit facility to fund its investment activities on an interim basis pending permanent equity or long term debt financing.
Currently, there are $70 million of outstanding borrowings under the credit facility.
Health and Retirement is a real estate investment trust which primarily owns nursing homes, retirement living properties, medical office buildings and clinics.
